//: exactOptionalPropertyTypes is off here on purpose. Every optional property in this package models a key
a user may omit from YAML/JSON, not a key whose value may be `undefined`, and the CLI merges defaults over
loaded configuration objects. Turning it on would force `| undefined` unions that misdescribe the authored
format and change the generated schema. The rest of the repository policy applies unchanged.
`types: []` and `skipLibCheck: false` describe the environment a consumer of this package actually has, so
tests/config-import.acceptance.ts is compiled here rather than with the Bun test: it proves the model is
usable with no ambient globals at all.
